description: Covers verifying facts and sources at the content level: checking that a cited source actually contains and supports the claim it is cited for (claim-source alignment), assessing source trustworthiness (peer-review status, venue reputation, predatory-publishing signals, primary vs secondary), and flagging fabricated or misattributed support. Use PROACTIVELY whenever the agent itself asserts checkable facts or attaches sources to claims, and when the user asks to fact-check a document, verify that references support their claims, or assess whether a source is trustworthy. (rseng-citation-hygiene verifies references exist and are unretracted; rseng-research-integrity checks a document's own numbers.)
